title: Hub request and response helpers
responsibility: Build uncached hub JSON responses and validate common query and body fields.

inputs.name: hubQuery.request
inputs.description: A Fetch Request whose URL query supplies the selection values. Only entityId and commit are validated: entityId must match a dotted lowercase unit ID and commit must be 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters; branch, path, version, sha256 and threadId are copied as strings and default to empty strings.

inputs.name: hubHttpFailure.error
inputs.description: An arbitrary error value inspected for a code property when it is an object. A string code in the public status map selects that public error; other values fall back to unavailable.
inputs.unknownReason: The catch boundary may receive any value and inspects only a recognized public error code.

inputs.name: hubHttp.value
inputs.description: A value passed to Response.json as the response body. It must be JSON-serializable or response construction can throw.
inputs.unknownReason: This helper emits JSON for responses whose shape is selected by the caller.

inputs.name: hubHttp.status
inputs.description: The HTTP status passed to Response.json. It defaults to 200 and must be accepted by the Fetch Response implementation.

inputs.name: hubBody.request
inputs.description: A Fetch Request whose Content-Type begins with application/json and whose body is limited to 20,000 bytes. The bytes must decode as fatal UTF-8 and parse as a non-null, non-array JSON object; other content types, oversized bodies, or invalid content invoke hubFail('invalid-input').

outputs.name: hubHttp
outputs.description: A Fetch Response containing the JSON encoding of value with the supplied HTTP status. It sets Cache-Control: no-store, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

outputs.name: hubQuery
outputs.type: { entityId: string; commit: string; branch: string; path: string; version: string; sha256: string; threadId: string; }
outputs.description: An object with entityId, commit, branch, path, version, sha256 and threadId when the required identifiers pass validation. Missing query fields are returned as empty strings; invalid entityId or commit invokes hubFail('invalid-input').

outputs.name: hubBody
outputs.description: Resolves to the parsed non-null, non-array JSON object. The helper accepts only a Content-Type beginning with application/json and body bytes within its 20,000-byte limit; decode, parse or shape failures invoke hubFail('invalid-input').

outputs.name: hubHttpFailure
outputs.description: A Fetch Response with a JSON error code and the mapped status for a recognized public code. Missing, non-string or unrecognized codes become unavailable with status 503.

errors.name: invalid-input
errors.description: hubFail is invoked with this code when hubQuery rejects entityId or commit, or hubBody rejects the content type, body limit, UTF-8, JSON or parsed object shape.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Response.json can throw this when value cannot be serialized as JSON.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Response.json can throw this when status is outside the supported response status range.
